decision.summary: Two prominent multi-axis step events: first near 520–530 (N/E up, U down), second near 545 (stronger N/E up, U down) with ambiguous partial return near 575. Later windows (605+) show only smooth secular trends and noise—no further candidate anomalies.

regions.observation: N/E/U show correlated multi-sample step-up around index 520–530, with N rising ~6 units, E ~25, U dropping ~15; no clear return within window, though U shows a possible partial rebound after 535. The step is abrupt (2–3 samples) and sustained, distinct from surrounding noise.

At index ~545, U drops sharply (~15 units over 2–3 samples), followed by E stepping up ~25 units at same index; N also steps up ~20 units. A second, smaller opposing step occurs near index 575 in U (partial recovery) and E (small dip), suggesting possible superposed or incomplete reversal. Both axes sustain offset through 664.
